name: Kohl's Rewards Visa
balance_transfer_fee: $0 at the standard Transfer APR, or 4% at any promotional APR Capital One may offer

welcome_bonus.requirement: valid on qualifying purchases for one transaction with your new Kohl's Card within 30 days of credit availability

verdict.text: Strong only for regular Kohl's shoppers who'll spend the Kohl's Cash

earn_note: The 7.5% at Kohl's is the 5% every Kohl's Rewards member earns plus 2.5% for paying with this card, and it needs the card linked to your Kohl's Rewards account. On a split payment, only the part charged to the card gets 7.5%, and purchases through a mobile or digital wallet may earn less. Every category pays out in Kohl's Cash, not usable dollars, so the gas and grocery rates are really discounts good only at Kohl's. Groceries bought at superstores, warehouse clubs and convenience stores earn 1%. Gift cards don't earn, and Kohl's Cash can't be spent on Sephora at Kohl's.

points.per_100k: Not applicable: rewards accrue as a Kohl's Cash balance, not a points currency
points.note: Rewards convert to $5 Kohl's Cash increments around the 1st of the following month and expire 30 days later, the single biggest catch on the card. A balance under $5 carries forward, but it expires if it stays under $5 for more than 12 months.

transfer_partners.highlight: No transfer partners: Kohl's Cash is a closed-loop, single-retailer currency with no travel or cash-out option.

insurance.detail: Not included in the Kohl's Rewards Visa Guide to Benefits
Not included in the Kohl's Rewards Visa Guide to Benefits
Not included in the Kohl's Rewards Visa Guide to Benefits

protection_note: Visa Signature status brings 24/7 concierge and travel/emergency assistance, but the Kohl's Rewards Visa Guide to Benefits includes no purchase protection, extended warranty, rental or trip coverage. Treat it as unprotected for big-ticket purchases.
rental_note: No rental car coverage: the card's Guide to Benefits doesn't include any.

status_perks.name: Most Valued Customer (MVC)
status_perks.note: Spend $600 at Kohl's stores or Kohls.com in a calendar year to reach MVC status, which runs through December 31 of the following year and brings monthly free shipping opportunities.

services.name: 24-hour Visa Signature Concierge
services.detail: Reservation and travel-assistance concierge, standard Visa Signature benefit.

services.name: Kohl's-only promotions
services.detail: Monthly exclusive discounts and an annual cardholder-anniversary offer on top of standard Kohl's Cash earnings.

services.name: Card lock & account management
services.detail: Mobile app card lock, autopay, and flexible due-date selection via Capital One's servicing platform.

services.name: Visa Signature extras
services.detail: Roadside Dispatch (pay per use, about $80 a call), the Visa Signature Luxury Hotel Collection, and Troon Rewards golf discounts.

additional_cards.title: Additional cards

benefits.text: Earns the same Kohl's Cash rate (into your account)

additional_cards.note: Free to add: useful for consolidating a household's Kohl's spend to hit MVC status faster, but doesn't help beat the 30-day Kohl's Cash expiration.

timeline.text: Capital One introduced the Visa-branded Kohl's Rewards Visa alongside the long-standing store-only Kohl's Card, letting cardholders earn Kohl's Cash on purchases made anywhere Visa is accepted, not just at Kohl's.
Capital One became the issuer of Kohl's private-label credit cards, acquiring the existing portfolio from JPMorgan Chase.
